newsitem.title: USA: Imation, Presstek in imaging pact.
newsitem.headline: Imation, Presstek in imaging pact.

text.p: Imation Corp said Wednesday it has entered into a digital imaging agreement with Presstek Inc.
Presstek will be the first equipment manufacturer to be qualified to develop imagers for Imation's Matchprint Laser Proof digital halftone proofing system, Imation said.
Presstek and Imation expect to coordinate release of both the imager and Matchprint Laser Proof products in third quarter 1997.
Imation was recently spun off from Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co.
Presstek, based in Hudson, New Hampshire, manufactures thermal imaging devices for computer-to-plate direct imaging. Its shares rose 7-1/4 to 59-1/2 on Wednesday morning.
